product: Apple for Business — device fleet pricing
billing: per device, one-time purchase or 24-month lease via Apple Financial Services; volume pricing applies automatically above 20 units on a single order

tiers.name: Growth
tiers.price_per_device: MacBook Air (M5) from $949/device (5% volume discount); iPhone 17 from $854/device

tiers.name: Enterprise
features: custom fleet pricing based on device mix and term
trade-in program for the old fleet
tiers.note: Custom quote required above 100 devices; final price depends on device mix (Mac/iPhone/iPad ratio), lease vs. purchase, and trade-in credit for the existing fleet.

device_lineup.note: 14-inch; for engineering/design-heavy roles; also available in M5 Pro and M5 Max, and a 16-inch size
desktop; for fixed workstations, labs, kiosks
M5 Max or M5 Ultra; for heavy compute/render workloads
thinnest model in the lineup, single rear camera
foldable, 7.6-inch inner display, A20 Pro chip
field teams, shared-device kiosks; A16 chip
A17 Pro chip; pocketable field/inventory use
active noise cancellation, common add-on for call-center/field roles

financing_note: Apple Financial Services offers 24-month business leasing as an alternative to upfront purchase — ask about it if budget, not total cost, is the blocker.
fleet_scope_note: Most fleet orders are Mac + iPhone + iPad; Watch and AirPods are usually added per-role (field/outdoor staff, call-center) rather than fleet-wide, and follow the same volume pricing when bundled onto the same order.
